title: charlab review r1: 8 characters x 36 cells. Sweet spot medium/compact/64 (chibi/48 alt); round 2 = Rio, Hana, Nova
question: Which character, body, size and tier combinations from the data-driven 3D -> pixel walk lab are closest to shippable, where does the pipeline break, and what should round 2 fix?
method: Art, animation and game-director panel. Looked at every boards.png and at the 4x sheets and 1x strips of key cells. Ran pxeval seq on 10 SE walks, plus a connectivity scan over all 6,912 frames (scripts in charlab/review_r1/scripts). Opus second opinion on 3 boards.
result: Ranking: Rio, Hana, Nova (feasibility 4/5), then Zip, Mika, Kai, Fern, Marin. Colours and outline are clean everywhere. The slim body fragments in 18-23 % of frames at 64/96 px. The E profile loses the face (0 eyes in 43 % of Fern's E frames, 34 % of Hana's). 96 px boils. Detailed decals turn into specks below 64 px. Bodies read as tubes or barrels with A-pose arms, so posture does not look feminine.
verdict: Viable base generator, not yet beautiful. Iterate Rio and Hana at medium/compact/64 and Nova at medium/chibi/48. Lab fixes, in priority order: limb connectivity gate, compact_f feminine body, walk (narrow step, hip sway, elbow bend), eyes on skin in profile, shading hysteresis. Drop slim below 64 and drop 96.
